answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 54 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 16 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 54 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 420 bought sponsors, each risking real money. The wharf of the design is public, the falcon of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the timber of honest work is what finally pays.
